verdict.rationale: Circle documents a compliance screening endpoint for blockchain addresses (circle-docs-26) and mentions 'built-in compliance guardrails' for agent wallets (circle-docs-6), suggesting some programmatic compliance tooling exists, but there is no documented KYC/KYB onboarding flow for customers or recipients — Circle Mint access is described as a manual 'qualified businesses can apply' process (circle-docs-13), not an API-driven identity verification flow. Missing for 10: documented KYC/KYB onboarding endpoints (identity/business verification), explicit 'clear counterparty before send' gating logic, and any evidence of end-to-end programmatic approval workflow.
